description: `:nums[2]` reads the 1-based second element of a list place (issue #94, spec/execution-model.md:232-291's "Postfix reads"). The postfix-read GRAMMAR is unconditional Core syntax (spec/conformance.md:120), but EXECUTING the list case is Data-profile behavior — spec/conformance.md:269, "only Data-claiming implementations execute the list case" — so this executed fixture declares both. It declared Core alone until issue #790 made an executed fixture's `profiles` array enforced rather than merely selective; the earlier "Core-scope postfix index selector" wording was the under-declaration written down.
